blocks.text: Arrival in Lima and Belmond Miraflores Park

provenance.rationale: Compose the short arrival-day title from the Lima arrival and Belmond Miraflores Park transfer in Word.

blocks.text:
You arrive at Jorge Chávez Airport in Lima. An English-speaking guide will meet you at the exit, and an executive-class transfer will take you to **Belmond Miraflores Park** by the ocean.

Miraflores stretches along high coastal cliffs. Park paths run above the ocean, with surfers and long lines of waves visible below. This part of the city has more open space and wider horizons than the historic centre.

The rooms at Belmond Miraflores Park face the ocean. On the rooftop, there is a heated swimming pool and a terrace overlooking the coastline.

The rest of the day is free after your flight. Relax at the hotel or walk along the Malecón promenade, where people stroll, cycle and watch the sunset.
